Chapter 17: Daring Greatly — Living with Courage and Heart.
When you really think about it, daring greatly isn’t all about those big, flashy moments or taking wild leaps of faith. It’s more about those little, everyday choices—the ones where you decide to show up, let yourself be seen, and live with a full, open heart.
Picture this: there’s a guy who’s always used sarcasm as his armor. One day, he chooses to drop the act and tells his friends what he’s actually struggling with. Is it awkward? Absolutely. But something amazing happens—their friendships get stronger, more real.
Or imagine a woman who’s always worried about failing. She finally signs up for that class she’s secretly wanted to take for years. The first day? It’s nerve-wracking, no doubt. But soon, she’s discovering the joy of learning something totally new.
Most of us wait for that perfect moment to be brave. But the truth is, courage gets built in those ordinary moments—like saying sorry after an argument, reaching out for help, or just picking yourself up and trying again after things didn’t go your way.
Here’s something worth remembering. This whole journey? It isn’t about never feeling scared. It’s about taking a step forward anyway, trusting that being vulnerable is what really leads us to deeper connections, more creativity, and true joy.
